analysis_review.name: Modelling analysis review

paper_learning_review.name: Paper learning churn review

learning_director.name: Learning Director review
learning_director.cadence: Sunday 10:55 UTC after paper-learning-review; **primary: cron-job.org** 55 10 * * 0. Observe-only regime/convergence/vision synthesis. Disable via docs/data/paper_automation/review_policy.json. docs/ops/learning-director.md; scheduling: docs/ops/orchestrator-cron.md.

ops_monitor.name: FTSE Ops Monitor
ops_monitor.cadence: Daily 07:45 UTC morning + 13:15 UTC catch-up (GitHub schedule + external cron). Workflow/artifact health, safe auto-fixes, re-verify; SMTP deferred until day's slots complete when only pre-slot/recovery findings remain. docs/ops/ops-monitor.md.

ci_main_nightly.name: CI main nightly
ci_main_nightly.cadence: Daily 07:30 UTC full pytest on main (GitHub schedule + external cron). Catches latent test coupling to docs/data commits that skip push CI. Failures draft ci-fix tasks via ci-fix-responder. docs/ops/ci-fix-automation.md.

data_backup.name: FTSE Data Backup
data_backup.cadence: Sunday 12:30 UTC after email bundle; **primary: cron-job.org** 30 12 * * 0. Tier-1 docs/data tarball + manifest; GitHub artifact (90d), chunked SMTP email to BACKUP_EMAIL_TO, optional S3 via BACKUP_S3_URI. docs/ops/data-backup.md.
